summary: Biped-only round: six reference motions, four bodies, 24 experimental direct adaptations. Review naturalness, floor support and transitions; finite exports do not establish motion quality.

bodies.label: Meshy fighter (test only)
bodies.attribution: BJJ Jiu-Jitsu Woman Girl Fighter Free by Tulio Portela, CC BY 4.0. Experimental rig/skin by C08 Motion Lab. https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/bjj-jiu-jitsu-woman-girl-fighter-free-8077cada67a14af18249b6af687fcc3c

tests.title: Ukemi
tests.description: Direct recovered SOMA movement adapted independently to four original biped rigs, with synchronized playback. No MotionBricks generation and no G1 intermediate.
limitations: Floor roll and hand/back support; preserve intentional inversion
Performer is partially cropped near the end
Monocular recovery estimates depth and hidden limbs; no independent ground truth for these videos.
Whole-body vertical grounding translates each target to keep its lowest skinned vertex 15 mm above the floor at authored keys. It can alter vertical motion; no support, collision or balance solve.
Original fingers remain at rest; no source finger capture.
Experimental derived takes for visual review; not automatically accepted for game use.
